description: AECOM used IESVE for the Founders Memorial Museum and Eastern Integrated Health Campus in Singapore. The narrative describes shading, facade and daylight analyses, natural ventilation and detailed HVAC simulation. ApacheHVAC was used to model passive displacement cooling and other system controls. These analyses supported design comparisons and Green Mark performance assessments for the two projects. The source describes designs and certification claims. It contains an ambiguous annual-energy number, which is not reproduced as a verified result. Completed operational performance is not established. This public HTML case narrative is published by IES and can be read without payment. Its reuse licence is not stated. Access to the described software, input data and project models is not established by the public page. The source does not give a complete study period or all spatial and temporal model resolutions. Reported results are provider claims and have not been independently reproduced. The case supports the documented infrastructure simulation use and is linked to the named modelling resources. Only metadata and the case description were inspected; no data or model files were downloaded.
